section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Rear Suspension
title: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION

content.description: Illustration showing the removal of shock absorber upper mounting nut using a wrench

content.text: (b) If replacing the shock absorber, remove the nut holding the shock absorber to the body, and remove the shock absorber.
Use a screwdriver to keep the shaft from turning.

content.description: Illustration showing hand removing coil spring from rear suspension with visible coil spring and suspension arm

content.text: (a) Start to lower the rear suspension arm.
Be careful not to pull the brake line and parking brake cable.
(b) While lowering the rear suspension arm, remove the coil spring and upper and lower insulators.
INSTALLATION OF COIL SPRING AND SHOCK ABSORBER

content.description: Illustration showing installation of lower insulator on rear suspension arm

content.text: 1. PUT LOWER INSULATOR ON REAR SUSPENSION ARM

content.description: Illustration showing hand placing upper insulator on coil spring

content.text: 2. PUT UPPER INSULATOR ON COIL SPRING

content.description: Illustration showing standalone coil spring assembly

content.text: (a) Jack up the rear suspension arm.
(b) Check that the lower insulator is installed correctly. If the insulator is not in correct position, reinstall the coil spring.
